blocks.prompt: 1 (i) Find the common difference and write the next two terms of the arithmetic sequence \(9, 16, 23, \ldots\)
blocks.explanation:
Sab se pehle dekhte hain ke list kis qisam ki hai: yeh A.P. (arithmetic progression) hai, yani har term mein ek hi number \(d\) jama hota hai.
Find kya karna hai? Common difference \(d\) (har do saath wali terms ka farq) aur agli do terms, yani \(a_4\) aur \(a_5\).
Plan: saath wali terms ko minus kar ke \(d\) nikalenge, phir aakhri term mein \(d\) jama karte jayenge.
steps:
Diya gaya hai: \(a_1 = 9,\ a_2 = 16,\ a_3 = 23\)
Humein find karna hai: \(d\), \(a_4\) aur \(a_5\).
Tareeqa: A.P. mein \(d = a_2 - a_1 = a_3 - a_2\) hota hai. Agli term hamesha pichhli term \(+\ d\) hoti hai, is liye \(d\) mil jaye to aage chalna bilkul aasaan hai.

Common difference nikalein
\[d = a_2 - a_1 = 16 - 9 = 7\]
\[a_3 - a_2 = 23 - 16 = 7\]
Kyun: A.P. ki pehchaan hi yeh hai ke har do padosi terms ka farq ek jaisa ho. Hum ne do jore check kiye aur dono mein 7 aaya, is liye yakeen ho gaya ke list waqai A.P. hai.
Dhyan dein: Hamesha baad wali term mein se pehli term minus karein (\(a_2 - a_1\)), ulta nahi; warna \(d\) ka sign ghalat ho jayega.

Agli do terms likhein
\[a_4 = a_3 + d = 23 + 7 = 30\]
\[a_5 = a_4 + d = 30 + 7 = 37\]
Kyun: A.P. mein ek qadam aage jane ka matlab hai ek dafa \(d\) jama karna. Jaise seedhi ke har dande ka faasla barabar hota hai, waise hi yahan har term 7 aage hai.

Tasdeeq: general term se
\[a_n = a_1 + (n - 1)d\]
\[a_5 = 9 + 4(7) = 37 \;\checkmark\]
Kyun: \(a_5\) tak pohanchne ke liye \(a_1\) mein 4 dafa \(d\) jama hota hai. Formula se bhi 37 aaya, matlab hum ne koi qadam nahi chhora.

blocks.prompt: 1 (ii) Find the common difference and write the next two terms of the arithmetic sequence \(5,\ 5 + \sqrt{2},\ 5 + 2\sqrt{2}, \ldots\)
blocks.explanation:
Yeh bhi A.P. hai, bas terms mein surd \(\sqrt{2}\) aa gaya hai. Ghabraane ki zaroorat nahi: \(\sqrt{2}\) ko ek letter ki tarah samjhein, jaise \(y\).
Find kya karna hai? \(d\) aur agli do terms.
Plan: padosi terms minus kar ke \(d\), phir aakhri term mein do dafa \(d\) jama.
steps:
Diya gaya hai: \(a_1 = 5,\ a_2 = 5 + \sqrt{2},\ a_3 = 5 + 2\sqrt{2}\)
Humein find karna hai: \(d\), \(a_4\) aur \(a_5\).
Tareeqa: \(d = a_2 - a_1\); phir \(a_4 = a_3 + d\) aur \(a_5 = a_4 + d\). Tareeqa part (i) wala hi hai, sirf numbers mein surd hai.

Common difference nikalein
\[d = (5 + \sqrt{2}) - 5 = \sqrt{2}\]
\[a_3 - a_2 = (5 + 2\sqrt{2}) - (5 + \sqrt{2})\]
\[= \sqrt{2}\]
Kyun: 5 aur 5 cancel ho gaye. Phir \(2\sqrt{2} - \sqrt{2} = \sqrt{2}\), bilkul waise jaise \(2y - y = y\). Dono farq barabar aaye, to \(d = \sqrt{2}\) pakka hai.
Dhyan dein: \(\sqrt{2}\) ko decimal (1.41...) mein badalne ki zaroorat nahi; exact jawab surd mein hi likha jata hai.

Agli do terms likhein
\[a_4 = 5 + 2\sqrt{2} + \sqrt{2} = 5 + 3\sqrt{2}\]
\[a_5 = 5 + 3\sqrt{2} + \sqrt{2} = 5 + 4\sqrt{2}\]
Kyun: Har qadam par sirf \(\sqrt{2}\) ki ginti ek barhti hai: 1, 2, 3, 4. 5 apni jagah qaim rehta hai, kyunke woh har term mein shuru se mojood hai.

Tasdeeq: general term se
\[a_5 = a_1 + 4d\]
\[= 5 + 4\sqrt{2} \;\checkmark\]
Kyun: Formula \(a_n = a_1 + (n - 1)d\) se bhi wohi jawab aaya, is liye jawab sahi hai.
